Metadata.title: Central Riftbound
Metadata.description: Riftbound meta computed from tournament results, decklists, legends, players and deckbuilding tools.

Home.title: The meta, straight from tournament results
Home.lead: Power rankings that update themselves after every event, decklists, the best pilot of each legend and tools to build your own deck.
Home.featureMetaBody: Every legend placed by power and popularity or community-voted complexity, recalculated from real matches.
Home.featureLiveBody: Pairings and standings of Regional Qualifiers that refresh on their own while the event runs.
Home.featureLegendsBody: Win rate, conversion, matchups and the best players of each legend, with confidence intervals.
Home.featureToolsBody: Card search, deck validation, deck codes and exports compatible with the tools you already use.
